hooks.name: grelot identity and manual
hooks.description: Gives a new chat its grelot identity card and manual, or the line that asks it to register.

hooks.name: grelot unread mail
hooks.description: Starts every turn with one grelot line: the unread count, or the line that asks the chat to register.

hooks.name: grelot hold for mail or registration
hooks.description: Holds the end of a turn once when new mail is unread or the chat has not registered.

hooks.name: grelot offline for a deleted chat
hooks.description: Tells grelot that a deleted chat has closed; every other session end does nothing.
